description:
Configure two URL redirects for the 'acmecorp.test' website using the Virtualmin control panel. 

1. A Permanent (301) redirect from source path '/old-products' to destination 'https://shop.example.com/products'.
2. A Temporary (302) redirect from source path '/survey' to destination 'https://forms.example.com/feedback'.

Navigate to the 'acmecorp.test' virtual server, find the Website Redirects configuration, add these two redirects, and apply the changes.
